Claire / Tom —

Great to speak yesterday. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and an abbreviated kickoff deck to get us to go-live. High level asks in this note:

1) Please review the MAP (tab: milestones) and confirm the target acceptance date for the SOW.
2) Confirm who from AlderTech will own the weekly status (name + role).
3) Do you have any blackout dates in May/June we should avoid for the technical kickoff?

Key milestones (from MAP v1.2):
- Week 1 (Apr 12–16): Finalize SOW and legal review (owner: AlderTech legal, Claire)
- Week 2 (Apr 19–23): Provisioning + credentials exchange (owner: Redwood eng, Ben Carter)
- Week 3 (Apr 26–30): Integration spike & sample data validation (owner: AlderTech eng, Tom)
- Week 5 (May 10–14): Pilot validation & acceptance criteria review (owner: CS, Laura Bennett)
- Week 8 (Jun 1–4): Production cutover window (target)

Attachments: AlderTech_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Kickoff_Deck_AlderTech.pptx (pptx)

If the timeline looks good I can lock in a 60-minute technical kickoff next Tuesday (Apr 20) at 10am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.
